lev.sticky.rationale: about 8 attributable actions per typed turn with 4 in 5 sticking; about 24 incl. subagent work with 9 in 10

lev.run.rationale: the 90th-percentile successful run is 15 actions for a regular user, 50 for a strong one

orc.parallel.rationale: 1 in 10 active ten-minute windows have two sessions working; 4 in 10

orc.fanout.rationale: a finished subagent every second episode; three per episode

orc.headless.rationale: one scripted run per active week; a dozen

orc.background.rationale: 1 in 10 child runs in the background; half

ver.vae.rationale: 4 in 10 code-edit turns checked after the last edit; 3 in 4

ver.closure.rationale: two thirds of failing checks pass later in the episode; nearly 9 in 10

ver.guardrails.rationale: one of three guardrails per active repo; most of them

ste.correction.rationale: 15% of briefs need a correction next; 6%

ste.interrupts.rationale: half of interrupts are early, substantive redirects; nearly 4 in 5

ctx.instructions.rationale: 4 in 10 active repos keep a maintained instruction file; 85%

ctx.artifacts.rationale: three provenance-weighted artifacts in use (two own skills plus a few installed); ten

ctx.hygiene.rationale: a third of compactions and episode starts are deliberate; two thirds

ctx.briefs.rationale: task briefs meet 2 of the 5 structure marks; more than 3

jud.switches.rationale: one deliberate model or effort switch per active week; four to five

jud.cost.rationale: 600k fresh tokens per landed commit or PR; 200k

del.landed.rationale: 45% of edit episodes reach a commit or PR within a day; 80%

del.rework.rationale: 12% of commits reverted or fixed up on the same files within 72 h; 5%

del.prs.rationale: one PR per active week; five
